title: Emergency Backups: AODB, FIDS, PACS, DC — Snapshot Initiated

commands.cmd: Get-Date
commands.output: Tuesday, October 20, 2026 09:00:00 AM

commands.cmd: Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -eq 'C' } | Select-Object DriveLetter, Size, AvailableFreeSpace
commands.output:
DriveLetter Size AvailableFreeSpace
---------- ---- --------------
C 450 GB 210 GB

commands.cmd: Write-Host "Initiating emergency snapshot backups for AODB, FIDS, PACS, and DC..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
commands.output: Initiating emergency snapshot backups for AODB, FIDS, PACS, and DC...

commands.cmd: Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Invoke-Command -ComputerName NCIA-PACS-CORE -ScriptBlock { Get-Service -Name 'SQL Server (MSSQLSERVER)' | Stop-Service -Force }
commands.output: Stopping service 'SQL Server (MSSQLSERVER)' on NCIA-PACS-CORE.

commands.cmd: Invoke-Command -ComputerName NCIA-PACS-CORE -ScriptBlock { Start-Transcript -Path 'C:\Logs\Transcript_AODB-FIDS-PACS-DC_090000-090020.txt' }
commands.output: Transcript started, output file is C:\Logs\Transcript_AODB-FIDS-PACS-DC_090000-090020.txt

commands.cmd: Invoke-Command -ComputerName NCIA-PACS-CORE -ScriptBlock { $backup = New-Object -ComObject 'MSXML2.DOMDocument'; $backup.async = $false; $backup.load('C:\AODB\Config\AODB_FIDS_PACS_DC.xml'); $backup.documentElement.selectNodes('//backup-target').item(0).text = 'SNAPSHOT'; $backup.save('C:\AODB\Config\AODB_FIDS_PACS_DC.xml'); Write-Output 'Backup target set to SNAPSHOT' }
commands.output: Backup target set to SNAPSHOT

commands.cmd: Invoke-Command -ComputerName NCIA-PACS-CORE -ScriptBlock { $backup = New-Object -ComObject 'MSXML2.DOMDocument'; $backup.async = $false; $backup.load('C:\AODB\Config\AODB_FIDS_PACS_DC.xml'); $backup.documentElement.selectNodes('//backup-target').item(0).text = 'SNAPSHOT'; $backup.save('C:\AODB\Config\AODB_FIDS_PACS_DC.xml'); Write-Output 'Backup target set to SNAPSHOT' }
commands.output: Backup target set to SNAPSHOT

commands.cmd: Invoke-Command -ComputerName NCIA-PACS-CORE -ScriptBlock { Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\AODB\Maintenance\AODB_IndexMaintenance.ps1' -ArgumentList '-Mode Snapshot' -Wait }
commands.output:
Executing AODB_IndexMaintenance.ps1 with -Mode Snapshot
[INFO] AODB database snapshot initiated at 09:00:05
[INFO] FIDS data feed configuration backup completed
[INFO] PACS session logs archived
[INFO] DC power state synchronized
[INFO] All targets: AODB, FIDS, PACS, DC — SNAPSHOT in progress

commands.cmd: Write-Host "Backup status: 100% complete. Snapshot files stored in \AODB\Backups\2026-10-20-090000" -ForegroundColor Green
commands.output: Backup status: 100% complete. Snapshot files stored in \AODB\Backups\2026-10-20-090000

commands.cmd: Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\AODB\Backups\2026-10-20-090000' | Format-Table -Property Name, Length, LastWriteTime

Name Length LastWriteTime

AODB_FIDS_Config_Backup.xml 4.7 KB 10/20/2026 09:00:30 AM

commands.cmd: Write-Host "Emergency backup cycle completed. All critical systems backed up to gold image (09:00:45)." -ForegroundColor Green
commands.output: Emergency backup cycle completed. All critical systems backed up to gold image (09:00:45).

instructorNote: This is a defensive insurance move. The team has bought time for recovery if the bomb triggers. Watch for teams who skip this and rush to stop the bomb without backup.
